g.text: BrowserConnector: one request (thread pool, 10 s per connection)
read headers (max 64 KB) and body (max 1 MB, UTF-8)
204, CORS echoed for extension origins only
protocol = 3 when x-ttm-protocol asks for 3 or more, else 2
(rebuilt on the UI thread after TreeChanged / DataSaved)
v3: the tab for lang= / langId= (404 when not pasted)
sanitize, unique title, add to the local root, save
marshal to the UI thread: 404 / 403 read-only / 409 sync file missing
MainPage: flush the editor; 409 with unsaved edits
ConnectorLanguages.Write (409 for the default), editor reload, save
